requirements: No prerequisite task dependencies are required to start.
Owning repository has an active branch with contract/codegen artifacts synchronized to current baselines.

userStory.desire: As a Wesley Schema Compiler Engineer, I want complete per-op var/result schema wiring so generated hosts no longer require manual schema patching.

motivation.summary: Schema completeness is a prerequisite for trustworthy generated clients and pumps.
supportsOrUnblocks: Directly unblocks WES-002, WES-003, and WRK-002 retirement trajectory.
Eliminates fragile hand-edits in generated protocol surfaces.

acceptanceCriteria: Per-op var/result schemas are generated for all declared operations and queries without manual patch steps.
Generated schema mapping is consistent between Rust and TypeScript artifacts.
Known TODO seams in schema emitter are removed or replaced with deterministic implementation.

assertions: Schema completeness tests fail if any op/query lacks var/result schema entry.
Cross-language contract tests verify op schema parity between TS and Rust outputs.
Snapshot tests verify stable ordering of schema tables.
goldenPath: Run generator on representative schema set and verify full schema map emission.
Consume generated schemas in host client without post-processing patches.
edgeCases: Operations with optional/union payloads emit deterministic schema variants.
No-op schema changes do not reorder unrelated generated entries.
fuzzScale: Generate artifacts from large op catalogs and verify stable runtime memory footprint.
failureCases: Unsupported schema construct fails generator with precise source location.
Schema hash mismatch between TS/Rust outputs fails generation job.

inScope: Code, tests, and docs directly required to complete WES-001: Complete per-op var/result schema wiring.
Boundary contracts and adapters touched by this task within project ownership.
Task-level observability needed to debug deterministic behavior and integration outcomes.
outOfScope: Unrelated feature work outside dependency chain impact.
Broad redesigns not required to satisfy acceptance criteria for this task.
Cross-repo migration work not explicitly referenced by this task dependencies.

definitionOfDone: All acceptance criteria are satisfied with linked test evidence.
Task metadata is updated to DONE in DAG source for WES-001.
Any architecture exceptions are either removed or documented with owner + expiry.
No workaround-only seams were introduced to complete this task.
